items.title: Tesla (TSLA)’s Autopilot Software Wins Over a Sixth European Country
items.summary: On September 8, 2026, Reuters reported that Slovenia approved Tesla, Inc. (NASDAQ:TSLA)’s FSD Supervised driver-assistance system for its roads. Slovenia became the sixth European country to clear the software ahead of a potential European Union-wide vote that Tesla expects as early as October 6.
